hermeticity.method: Focus-only baselines were formed from 100:1 and its branch inventories, then context_root_cues were evaluated in packet order as activators or revisers.
hermeticity.limitations: The packet gives the focus ayah and full local context at once, so this is a reconstructed hermetic focus trace rather than a staged blind discovery log; no sources beyond the prompt, schema, and packet were used.

discarded_or_unchanged: و ر ي/B005-B008 concealment, behindness, descendants, and creation did not add a sharper focus-anchored mechanism than the fire emergence branches.
ق د ح/B002-B010 supplied interesting side images such as defect, cup, arrow-lot, and deliberation, but they either repeated striking-contact weakly or lacked a changed reading anchored in 100:1.
ص ب ح/B003-B010 mostly stayed as morning sub-branches or unrelated lexical material; B001 was sufficient for the threshold mechanism.
ث و ر/B004-B007 and ن ق ع/B003/B006-B009 were left aside because bull, curd, place-name, poison, and insult images did not visibly change the focus ayah.
ء ن س branches other than the human/interior transition were not retained; they named perception or sociability but did not alter the reading of عَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًا.
ر ب و under ر ب ب was not retained; increase, high ground, and breathing-swelling were suggestive but weaker than the ربوبية/authority and nurture branches for this focus.
خ ي ر branches were treated structurally as the object of love; none was needed as a separate focus-changing branch beyond the moral mirror.
Animal, plant, vessel, and proper-name branches in several roots were not discarded for oddness alone, but because no distinct anchored changed reading survived.

strongest_changes: 100:2 revises ضَبْحًا from breath alone into breath-plus-ignition through hidden fire and striking.
100:4-5 turns running into a trace-making penetration of a gathered center.
100:9-10 reverses the surface charge into deep disclosure: soil, graves, breasts, and hidden origins are opened.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah is unusually overdetermined: its two roots support sound, speed, transgression, scorch, counted readiness, and recurrence before context arrives, then the context activates fire, dust, center-entry, moral witness, and excavation without forcing a single final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: How much weight downstream prose should give the non-dominant ع د د and ع و د mapped roots.
Whether the juridical redress branch of ع د و should be rendered explicitly or kept as latent support for witness/expert language.
Whether the water/soft-earth countercurrent is merely lexical noise or a useful contrast to the dominant fire-dust sequence.
